subject: APPLY COMMIT clause
notes: kb/Work PB3338 (wave 1154) and PB3540 (wave 1157): the APPLY COMMIT clause, COMMIT and ROLLBACK are provided for RELATIVE and INDEXED files, whose keyed store engine keeps the transaction (kb/Work PB3337); a SEQUENTIAL or LINE SEQUENTIAL file named in the clause is under commit control too, its transaction journal being kb/Work PB3340 (COBOL1709, which refused it, is retired) (Annex A.4.3 stays PARTIAL, docs/CONFORMANCE.md 5; this rule's obligations are met for every file the clause admits). GR3: an activation under the control of a recursive runtime element raises EC-FLOW-APPLY-COMMIT (Table 13's name for GR3/GR4's 'EC-FLOW-APPLY') under the ACTIVATING element's checking, latched by ProgramTable.CallProgram, and with checking off the clause stays inactive. A recursive runtime element (8.6.6: a RECURSIVE program, a function, a method) is a frame the module stack marks recursive, whatever pushed it: ProgramTable.CallProgram and ActivateMain for a program or function, the emitted method body (OoEmitter.EmitMethod) for a method, and TransactionControl.FlowForbidden asks ModuleStack.AnyRecursive, so an activation a method causes is forbidden like one a RECURSIVE program causes. Compiled paths: pb3338_ec_flow_apply_commit_under_recursive_element (a RECURSIVE program) and pb3540_ec_flow_apply_commit_under_method (a method), each CALLing an element with a clause with checking on at the CALL (the condition, the activation not made) and off (no condition, the clause inactive). Below 2023 the clause is refused (pb3540_commit_under_method_below_2023). retired-witness: conformance:wiseowl/cases/12.4.6.3-APPLY-COMMIT/declined-apply-commit (the commit and rollback facility is provided for the keyed organizations (kb/Work PB3338): the decline these witnessed is gone, and the rule is now witnessed by its own implementation) retired-witness: src/Cobol.Net.Compiler/Validation/DeclinedFacilityPass.cs#VisitApplyCommitClause (the commit and rollback facility is provided for the keyed organizations (kb/Work PB3338): the decline these witnessed is gone, and the rule is now witnessed by its own implementation) retired-witness: src/Cobol.Net.Runtime/Control/ProgramTable.cs#AnyRecursiveActive (kb/Work PB3540: the recursion question is the run unit's module stack's (ModuleStack.AnyRecursive), because a method is a frame there and no ProgramTable node; the table's own query, which could not see a method, is deleted)
